# James Praise

> Marketing and go-to-market operator since 2018, founder of Marketing In Action. Builds product marketing strategy, GTM systems, lifecycle and onboarding programs, and AI-assisted marketing tooling for founders and product-led companies in Africa, North America, and Europe.

James Praise has been a first or early marketing hire multiple times, turning ambiguous problems into structured, repeatable systems. His work spans product positioning and messaging, go-to-market strategy and execution, lifecycle and activation systems, growth experimentation, and AI-assisted workflows for marketing and research.

He is the founder of Marketing In Action (MIA), an execution-first marketing ecosystem for founders and marketers, and a cofounder and consultant at Titaja, a go-to-market-as-a-service agency for product-led companies.

- [Writing](https://jamespraise.xyz/writing/): Marketing In Action (marketinginaction.xyz) on go-to-market craft, RealTalk (realjaymes.substack.com) on personal wealth-building
